payload.summary: Draft PRs skip twelve CI jobs including Production UI, so agent-opened PRs get almost no real testing until someone marks them ready
payload.detail: Decide whether agent-opened PRs should open ready-for-review, or whether the draft skip-list should be narrower. Why: the standing instruction is to open PRs as draft, and .github/workflows/ci.yml gates 12 jobs on github.event.pull_request.draft != true (static-heavy, coverage, build, Production UI, Production UI critical, Ward Flow, Lighthouse and more), so a draft PR's green 'PR required' is far weaker than it looks and the change reaches main having had only the light baseline. Context: PR #2909 sat as a draft with zero browser coverage; npm run plan:browser names this case in its own output ('A draft PR is the case that bites'). Owner: user decision, then assistant. Confidence: high — verified by grep, 12 occurrences of the draft condition. Depends on: nothing.
payload.source: session 2026-09-20 /ledger sweep — nine-agent repo maturity review
